headline: South Africa Attracts R548 Billion in Special Economic Zone Investments
summary: South African Trade Minister Parks Tau announced that 141 companies have committed over R548 billion to special economic zones, projected to create 60,000 permanent jobs.
why: Large-scale industrial investments in special economic zones indicate foreign and domestic capital deployment toward infrastructure and manufacturing sectors.

impacts.name: South Africa
impacts.why: Substantial private capital commitments foster long-term industrial capacity and employment growth.
